question: Which Indian Cricketer played his 100th test match against Sri Lanka in Mohali in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __'**Virat Kohli'.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Virat Kohli, **born on 5 November 1988 is an Indian international cricketer and former captain of the **Indian national team**.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest **batsmen** of all time in international cricket.
 
• India will take on **Sri Lanka** in the upcoming two-match Test series, starting March 04 at Punjab Cricket Association IS Bindra Stadium in Mohali.
